searched_sources.portal_name: Roads and Transport Authority (RTA) Open Data Portal
searched_sources.result: Not found as open data. Audited all categories (legislation, reports, statistics).
searched_sources.governance_barrier: RTA classifies granular road traffic count volume as a restricted commercial asset under Administrative Resolution No. 740 of 2019 ('Sale of Traffic Count Data'). Third parties must apply for a Traffic Counts Permit and purchase sensor data commercially. No free open data exists.

searched_sources.result: City-wide aggregate published only. RTA reported ~3.5 million daytime vehicles network-wide across Dubai's 25,000 lane-km road system (November 2024 / 2025), but no segment-level volume is published.
